bpmn:participant.name: BPMN-07 | Custom Cake Configuration and Request Submission

bpmn:process.name: Custom Cake Configuration and Request Submission
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md BPMN-07; Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS 4.9.2-4.9.3, FR-CAKE-01-04, FR-CAP-21; NFR-SEC-08-09. Website: index.html and linked app/cake-builder.js, app/cake-data.js and app/cake-state.js. SRS/catalog govern prototype differences: reference images are optional; cake delivery terms are finalized in BPMN-08, with no pickup branch. Precondition: registered authenticated customer; reuse BPMN-30 for authentication before entering this process. Shared authorization checks remain enforced at submission. Vertical top-to-bottom descriptive BPMN; Customer and System are responsibility lanes within one pool. Output is an awaiting-review request, not an order. No resource reservation, quotation acceptance or payment occurs here. Reuse map: BPMN-30 owns sign-in; BPMN-08 owns owner review and quotations; BPMN-09 owns resource validation and reservation after quotation acceptance. FR-CAP-21 submission lead-time validation belongs locally to BPMN-07. BPMN-38 configures scheduling rules and is not a runtime validation subprocess. Preliminary estimation is FR-CAKE-04, not the owner pricing-approval workflow BPMN-40. These references are preconditions and downstream handoffs, not synchronous calls; therefore no call activity is added.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Present supported options and request form

bpmn:userTask.name: Choose cake options and requested fulfillment details
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-CAKE-01-02. Capture supported shape, size, flavor, color and icing choices, applicable supported extras and design notes, requested fulfillment date, contact and delivery information. Requested terms remain subject to owner review in BPMN-08.

bpmn:userTask.name: Optionally attach reference images
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-CAKE-03. Images are optional. Do not impose prototype image counts or file-size limits as SRS requirements.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Calculate and display preliminary estimate
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-CAKE-04. Calculate from configured prices of selected options and recalculate after edits. Display as preliminary, not the final quotation. Final design charges and delivery terms belong to BPMN-08.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Validate inputs, optional images and seven-day lead time
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-CAKE-01-03; FR-CAP-21; NFR-SEC-08-09. Recheck authenticated customer access, required fields and supported options server-side. If images are supplied, validate permitted type and size; reject executable or unsupported files. No image is valid optional input. At submission require requested fulfillment date at least seven calendar days after submission date, using bakery-local calendar dates. Do not reserve capacity or ingredients or invoke courier quotation.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Explain corrections; retain entered details
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Show specific correction messages for invalid options, required details, unsupported images or insufficient lead time. Allow correction or removal of optional images and resubmission; customer may leave instead.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Save request as Awaiting owner review
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Store customer association, configuration, valid supplied reference images, requested fulfillment details, preliminary estimate and submission timestamp. Preserve submission timestamp as evidence of FR-CAP-21 compliance. Later owner review must not invalidate timely submission if fulfillment remains feasible. Persistence failure retains the draft for retry and must not report successful submission.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Show Request submitted and open request details
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: After saving, show the submission confirmation and open the customer-facing request details with its reference and Awaiting owner review status. Owner review/quotation begins separately in BPMN-08. This subprocess creates no quotation, reservation, payment or confirmed order.

bpmn:userTask.name: View confirmation and request status
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: The customer sees that the request was received and can use the request details to follow quotations and updates. Viewing the confirmation is not required for owner review to begin.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Request submitted and awaiting owner review
No request submitted
bpmn:endEvent.bpmn:documentation: Customer leaves before submission; no request is created for owner review.

bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: Reference: BPMN-30 ? Authentication Precondition: customer is signed in. Reuse its sign-in flow before BPMN-07.

Reuse after submission: BPMN-08: owner review and quotations. BPMN-09: resource checks/reservations after quotation acceptance.
